title: Transactional emails, round 2
typeLocked: each brand's own locked faces (Newsreader or EB Garamond with Instrument Sans); the options differ by construction, not typeface
paletteLocked: each brand's own palette tokens; the options differ by construction, not color
premise: Every option puts what happened in one large sentence at the top and one real button under it; the three new ones also drop the colored header band and the step track, so the email reads as a page from the business, not a notification from a tool.
note: Tabs a to e are the same five emails in every option: a) signed, waiting on others (Palisade, 36 River Road); b) fully signed, PDF attached (Sun Mountain, 309 Cranbrook Circle); c) the alert to Jake (Xenia, Roam North website agreement); d) form receipt (Palisade inquiry, Jake's approved wording); e) fully signed with no open button (Perry Lawson, Consignment Agreement). Terms, parties, wording and logos are real. Signing dates and times are stand-ins. Use the phone toggle for the 390 view.
